name: topbar-nav
title: Topbar Nav
description: The wide-screen half of `Topbar` when its links hold groups: a row of plain links and group triggers, where a group opens a panel of its items, each with an optional icon and a one-line description. It is how a site that is a family of products lists them…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/topbar-nav

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/topbar-nav.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/topbar-nav';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/topbar-nav

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
